notes: Fixes the custom canonical firearm sheet opening in an inherited narrow dnd5e window that compressed the FEHA card.
Canonical weapon sheets now grow undersized Foundry item windows toward a usable desktop footprint without shrinking already-expanded windows.
Weapon art now uses a dedicated contained preview frame so wide gun images are shown whole instead of being cropped by square cover behavior.

The layout now responds to the actual sheet/container width: normal windows use a two-column art-plus-card layout, narrow windows stack cleanly, and stat grids fall back to two or one column instead of crushing text.
No weapon mechanics, balance values, hidden attack activities, cyberware, armor, grenade, or Quickhack rules changed.
